title: Normalized component section frames and compatible Čech functions
statement: Let $Y$ be a reduced scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-reduced-scheme], and let $i_a:Z_a\to Y$ be finitely many closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose images cover $Y$ and whose pairwise intersections for distinct indices are discrete. Let $M_a$ be invertible modules [def-sc-invertible-module] and $s_a\in\Gamma(Z_a,M_a)$ sections nonvanishing [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module] at every intersection involving $a$. There are an open cover $(U_b)$ of $Y$, units $g_{bc}\in\Gamma(Y,U_b\cap U_c)^\times$, functions $f_b\in\Gamma(Y,U_b)$, and free generators [def-sc-local-free-generator] $m_{ab}$ of $M_a$ over $i_a^{-1}U_b$. The units satisfy identity, inverse and Čech cocycle equations after restriction to every common open. The component frames satisfy $m_{ab}=i_a^\sharp(g_{bc})m_{ac}$ on $i_a^{-1}(U_b\cap U_c)$, the section satisfies $s_a=i_a^\sharp(f_b)m_{ab}$ on $i_a^{-1}U_b$, and $f_b g_{bc}=f_c$ on $U_b\cap U_c$. The cover index lies in universe $\max(u,v)$. No glued module or global section is asserted.

proof.text: On each distinct overlap use IsFreeGenerator.exists_unit_smul_eq to obtain component frame-ratio units. Lift their values and inverse values through the bijection to r,r'. Injectivity and multiplicativity prove rr'=1, so these lifts form a unit of the structure ring. Set the diagonal transition explicitly to 1. This is the proved private helper exists_transition_unit; exists_cech_of_component_frame_cover assembles the transitions.

proof.text: Restrict the component frame equations to any subopen of an overlap, using naturality of the structure map and module restriction. Cancel a free generator to check the inverse and cocycle scalar equations componentwise, then apply injectivity of the structure-section comparison. For a triple with distinct indices use either the first distinct pair or the second; when all three coincide all units are 1. For f_b g_bc=f_c, restrict both expressions for s_a to the overlap, substitute the frame equation, cancel the c-frame, and descend by injectivity. The diagonal coefficient equation is reflexive. All these checks are fully proved private lemmas in the module.

theorem exists_component_section_cech_data
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsReduced Y] {ι : Type v} [Finite ι]
    (Z : ι → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ a : ι, Z a ⟶ Y) [∀ a : ι, IsClosedImmersion (i a)]
    (hcover : (⋃ a : ι, Set.range (i a)) = Set.univ)
    (hdiscrete : ∀ a b : ι, a ≠ b →
      DiscreteTopology ↥(Set.range (i a) ∩ Set.range (i b)))
    (M : ∀ a : ι, (Z a).Modules) [∀ a : ι, (M a).IsInvertible]
    (s : ∀ a : ι, Γ(M a, ⊤))
    (hs : ∀ a b : ι, a ≠ b → Set.range (i a) ∩ Set.range (i b) ⊆
      i a '' nonvanishingLocus (M a) (s a)) :
    ∃ (κ : Type (max u v)) (U : κ → Y.Opens)
      (g : ∀ b c, Γ(Y, U b ⊓ U c)ˣ) (f : ∀ b, Γ(Y, U b))
      (m : ∀ a b, Γ(M a, (i a) ⁻¹ᵁ U b)),
      (⨆ b, U b) = ⊤ ∧
      (∀ b, g b b = 1) ∧
      (∀ b c (W : Y.Opens) (hb : W ≤ U b) (hc : W ≤ U c),
        Units.map (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf hc hb)).op).hom.toMonoidHom (g c b) =
          (Units.map (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf hb hc)).op).hom.toMonoidHom
            (g b c))⁻¹) ∧
      (∀ b c d (W : Y.Opens)
        (hb : W ≤ U b) (hc : W ≤ U c) (hd : W ≤ U d),
        Units.map (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf hb hd)).op).hom.toMonoidHom (g b d) =
          Units.map (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf hb hc)).op).hom.toMonoidHom (g b c) *
            Units.map (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf hc hd)).op).hom.toMonoidHom (g c d)) ∧
      (∀ a b, IsFreeGenerator (m a b)) ∧
      (∀ a b c,
        (M a).presheaf.map (homOfLE ((i a).preimage_mono inf_le_left)).op (m a b) =
          ((i a).app (U b ⊓ U c)).hom (g b c).val •
            (M a).presheaf.map (homOfLE ((i a).preimage_mono inf_le_right)).op (m a c)) ∧
      (∀ a b, (M a).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (s a) =
        ((i a).app (U b)).hom (f b) • m a b) ∧
      ∀ b c, Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (f b) * (g b c).val =
        Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op (f c)
